snippet.title: Hijack Jump – The Rage Game Where ANYONE Can THROW Stuff at You! (Official Trailer)
snippet.description:
Hijack Jump is a fast-paced rage platformer where you attempt to conquer chaotic parkour levels — alone or in co-op — while your community tries their absolute best to sabotage you.
Yes… your chat can literally throw objects at you, boost you, or troll you in real time.
Perfect for streamers, co-op chaos, and viewers who love causing mayhem.

🎮 Get Hijack Jump on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2926780/Hijack_Jump

🔥 Features:

Solo & Co-op parkour challenges

Real-time viewer interaction (twitch-style sabotage)

Physics-driven chaos

Endless funny moments and streamer reactions

Built using Photon Fusion & SpacetimeDB

💥 Great for streaming — your community becomes part of the gameplay!
Will they help you… or ruin your run? (We all know the answer.)

If you enjoy the trailer, wishlist or grab the game on Steam — it helps a ton! 🙌
